cells.gaps: No source found says other operators buy capacity on the government backbone that reaches every county, or that it runs on open-access or wholesale terms; the open-access route held is Bayobab's Mombasa-Malaba-Busia line, which does not reach every region. ODI says in 2025 that NOFBI Phase 2 is still incomplete, against the ministry's statement that it connected the last counties in 2017; it names no county without fibre.
cells.note: Fact 2026-11-10: Bayobab offers its Mombasa-Malaba-Busia route on open-access terms (KEN-016), but that route does not reach every region, and nothing says capacity is sold on NOFBI, which does; so stage 4 holds.
